# Workspace

4 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/workspaces/{organizationId}/members` | List the workspace's members |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/workspaces/{organizationId}` | Update workspace settings |
| PATCH | `/api/v1/workspaces/{organizationId}/members/{memberId}` | Change a member's role |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/workspaces/{organizationId}/members/{memberId}` | Remove a member from the workspace |

### GET /api/v1/workspaces/{organizationId}/members

List the workspace's members

Everyone in the workspace, oldest first. Any member may read it, as may the workspace's API keys.

The length of this list is what a plan's member limit is checked against — see `GET /entitlements` for the limit itself.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's members
  - `WorkspaceMembers`
    - `members`: array of `WorkspaceMember`, required
      - `id`: string, required
      - `userId`: string, required
      - `role`: string, required
      - `createdAt`: string, required
      - `user`: object, required
        - `name`: string, required
        - `email`: string, required
        - `image`: string | null, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/{organizationId}

Update workspace settings

Partial update of the workspace name and public-page fields. Owner/admin only; runs through Better Auth's organization plugin.

**Auth:** Session only (a browser login; an API key is refused)

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | yes |  |

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `WorkspacePatch`
  - `name`: string (max length 120)
  - `bio`: string (max length 500)
  - `website`: string (max length 300)
  - `publicProfileTitle`: string (max length 120)
  - `publicProfileTheme`: string (max length 50)
  - `publicProfileEnabled`: boolean
  - `linkedinEngagementAutomation`: boolean — Allow LinkedIn channels to run timed reactions, reshares and comments from a second connected account. Off by default: LinkedIn's API terms treat those as artificial engagement, so a LinkedIn post normally carries only the author's own comment from the publishing account.

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace after the update
  - `WorkspaceSummary`
    - `id`: string, required
    - `name`: string, required
    - `slug`: string | null, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
